## Description

Trades perceived inconsistency between a firm's equity, bonds, CDS or options using a structural credit model or relative-value signal.

## Where it may fit

Credit or equity repricing dislocations when instruments reflect inconsistent default/volatility expectations.

## Vehicles

Multi-strategy hedge funds, credit hedge funds, convertible/relative-value mandates.

## Required data

Equity prices/options, bonds or CDS spreads, balance-sheet data, rates, volatility and security terms.

## Caveats

Model risk is material; seniority, recovery assumptions, liquidity and basis risk mean legs may not converge.
